description: Run the configured regulation rule packs against the target repo and return per-control verdicts (pass/fail/unknown) with file-level evidence. Deterministic; no LLM involved.

config.description: Path to bouncer.config.json. Defaults to searching up from cwd.

packs.description: Restrict to these pack ids (e.g. uk-osa, uk-aadc).

status.description: Filter findings: fail, unknown (fail+unknown), or all (default).

name: compliance_check
title: Compliance Controls Check
